gemini.description: Google Gemini via the Gemini CLI. Use for very large context: long files, big PDFs, video/audio, or anything past Claude's window (Gemini's context is ~1M tokens). Auth: run `gemini` once and log in with your Google account.

codex.description: OpenAI GPT via the Codex CLI running as an MCP server. Use as a second-opinion reviewer on code Claude just wrote. Auth: run `codex` once and sign in with your ChatGPT account.
